definitions.explanation: A formal, on-site check conducted by an authority to verify compliance with laws, regulations, treaties, or internal rules. Typical contexts include tax audits by the National Tax Agency, nuclear non-proliferation inspections by the IAEA, workplace safety inspections, and internal-audit visits by a company headquarters to a branch. The nuance is of an authority coming in to look, not merely reviewing documents from afar.

examples.english: To be subjected to an inspection.

examples.english: An unannounced inspection uncovered one deficiency after another in the on-site safety management.

notes:
Compound of {査|さ} ('investigate; examine') and {察|さつ} ('observe; perceive'). Used as a verbal noun with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({査察|ささつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ 'to inspect'), but the noun form with verbs like ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧, ⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧, ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ is far more common.

USAGE:
- The inspecting side: {査察|ささつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ / ⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧ ('to carry out an inspection').
- The inspected side: {査察|ささつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ ('to be inspected'), {査察|ささつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ ('to have inspectors come in' — idiomatic, often about tax audits).
- Reserved for official, legally grounded inspections. For casual 'checking' use ⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧ ('routine check') or ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ ('examination'); for a quiet investigation use ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {査察|ささつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to be inspected
- {査察|ささつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: for inspectors to arrive (often used of tax raids)
- {査察|ささつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct an inspection
- {査察|ささつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}する→実施する：19634_jisshisuru⟧: to carry out an inspection
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}き{打|う}ち→抜き打ち：26006_nukiuchi⟧{査察|ささつ}: unannounced inspection
- ⟦{税務|ぜいむ}→税務：30025_zeimu⟧{査察|ささつ}: tax audit
- {査察|ささつ}{官|かん}: inspector (official title)
- {査察|ささつ}⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧: inspection team

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: examination; inspection — broader; includes medical tests, product quality checks, and routine inspections. {査察|ささつ} specifically implies a regulatory on-site visit.
- ⟦{監査|かんさ}→監査：05972_kansa⟧: audit — typically financial/document review; can be on-site but the focus is books and records.
- ⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧: routine check; inspection — self-inspection or maintenance check.
- ⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: investigation; survey — research-oriented, not enforcement-oriented.

CULTURAL NOTE:
In news headlines, {査察|ささつ} often evokes either ⟦{税務|ぜいむ}→税務：30025_zeimu⟧{査察|ささつ} (tax raids on suspected tax evaders, famously dramatized in the film 'A Taxing Woman' / マルサ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧) or IAEA nuclear inspections of North Korea and Iran.
